pages.title: Saints and Shades
pages.text: $(bold)Companions' bosses: crystallised blood and its netherite arms and armour, the Sacred Pontiff's relic gold, old cloth and holy robes, and the demon flesh of the Shades.$(br2)$(thing)Ashen Age$(n), ring 9.$(br)$(thing)40 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Champion.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Kill the Sacred Pontiff or a Shade$(n)$(br2)Pays 6 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.
